多人派对合作抽象游戏，主打一个欢乐搞怪，主线就是多人合作闯关，最多支持四人联机，房间组队整体比较流畅，每个房间都算一个小关卡，过关需要不同方式，初见需要熟悉，队友之间可以互相攻击的，当你想整蛊队友时可以毫无压力进行攻击，阻碍队友过关，有特殊药品可以吃，会触发特殊效果和发癫，人物会死亡也可以让队友救援。

[h2] 联机搞笑的逃出精神病院之旅 [/h2] 《超能副作用》是一款轻松搞怪的联机闯关游戏，本作可以联机也可以单人游玩，玩家将扮演一个在精神病院的神经病人，闯过一道道关卡，最终成功逃离这所变态的精神病院。在关卡中都是一些益智游戏，比如说打败在里面的保卫以及躲避激光镭射、触发机关打开大门等等，流程倒是挺简单的，但每一个房间的难度都会一直上升，有时还需要进行合作，单人游玩的话比较痛苦，建议还是找朋友一起搭人梯或者之类的。 本作的特点是里面的药丸会有各种副作用，比如说呕吐，放屁以及发电发光等等。玩家能在关卡里收集到货币，也就是棒棒糖，棒棒糖的个数可以在外面的售货机里面买到物品，比如说回复道具，但是会有副作用。 游戏里也会有各种道具和药丸，比如说在打败保卫的关卡里，需要车上棒棒糖，这样会让玩家的身体变大或者变小来造成伤害，某些药丸的副作用可能也是破局的关键，就比如说某一关需要玩家将足球放置在相应的位置才能打开大门，有一些是在高处，这时候就需要放屁来，进行高度上的位移。 总的来说，本作还是相当欢乐的，特别是与朋友游玩时，药丸的副作用也会伤及到队友，或者造成意想不到的效果，游玩的氛围比较轻松愉快，很适合情侣或者朋友游玩，还是挺推荐的。 [quote]关注「 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/42276832//]鸿源鉴游组」 [/url] [/quote] [u][b] 会当逢佳游，始可见鸿源。 [/b][/u]

只有神经病才能尝试的游戏，这是一款非常无厘头但设计想法又十分有创意的闯关游戏，在这里我们将可以拉上自己的小伙伴们一同来体验这里的神奇，整体的画风是偏向于玩具卡通风格，各种各样的房间玩法让玩家们每过一关都是全新的游戏体验，游戏中每个玩家之间还可以相互攻击来迫害，或者选择与其进行合作共同逃出这里，游戏中还设置了棒棒糖货币能用来购买其他装备道具，进一步增加游戏的趣味程度，整体值得推荐很值得多人尝试。 [quote]关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/36224058/]老实人鉴赏家 [/url] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/laoshirenLSR]老实人评测[/url]：独立游戏爱好者聚集地，黄油绅士交流中心。 不错过游戏的亮点，不放过游戏的槽点，带给玩家最直观的测评感受。[/quote]

I started playing in Early Access, and even then there were some performance issues, bugs, and overly difficult platforming, but the fun of the graphical style and the chaos that is happening made up for it. With the release, the bugs and micro-freezes only increased, the platforming became more annoying, and the cooperation is just for show (the most you can do is revive a fallen comrade, who at this time is stuck upside down and can't even watch other players). A curious idea stymied by poor execution. I can't recommend it right now.

I do recommend this game, but I feel like there are a few things that could be improved. I will say that I did have a lot of fun playing this game. I really like the customization options for the characters and I do love solving puzzles. I do however feel that it should be marketed as a 2-4 person game, because some of the puzzles in Therapy I don't see how you can do with only one person. I also didn't get any achievements for beating the Therapy levels and the friend that I was playing with did, so that is something that might need to be looked at.

S.E.M.I is pretty fun! I wish i had friends that had it but it works singleplayer as well! However using a controller i didnt know some of the controls such as throwing until i tried holding RT. (Only used cohntroller because my right hand is shakey as hell and makes it hard to use the mouse) 9/10

This game is pure chaos. Its a lot of fun with close friends. The pill side effects are hysterical and the puzzles are interesting enough that you can get stuck. The way you are downed is so stupid and funny we spent to much time just hurting each other. 10/10 game experience.

I honestly love how goofy this game is. It is so much fun! I love the different 'side effects' and the customisation of the characters. The puzzles are funny too, I don't find them stressful. All in all I find this is a nice chill game!

So fun game to play with friends. U actually have to use brain. The only real issue I had was motion blur. If you have it turned off, it still feels on at times, which can grate during fast motion. I just hope the devs take it out completely in an update. Overall, a very fun co-op game 8/10

Every session feels different, and the combination of strange powers, slapstick combat, and rough edges gives it a unique charm. It’s chaotic fun, best enjoyed with friends...
Visuals are charming and expressive, with character quirks that bring the cast to life. The color palette is warm and inviting, even during gameplay moments.
Co-op online game about escaping from special clinic! Here you & up to 3 of feeble-minded loyal friends in role of patients fight with staff & other patients & find yourself in unexpected situations!
A wild co-op escape-game where pills grant weird powers and chaos is constant. I loved the unpredictability. A bit rough around edges, but fun.
Fast paced and full of surprises taking a drug turns your character into something absurd, and you and friends scramble for freedom. Polishing needed.
Great party game vibe for 1-4 players. The clinic setting and mutated abilities made each session memorable. Wish for more map variety.
💊 S.E.M.I. turns chaos into comedy with wild abilities unpredictable pills and frantic co-op escapes. Random rooms goofy physics and nonstop mayhem make every run hysterical with friends 🤪
Creative puzzles and unstable powerups make progression feel dynamic. You never fully know what side effect comes next, so teamwork and adaptability become the most valuable tools.
Very engaging action-roguelike. I liked the mix of strategy and chaos. More map variety would be welcome.
The side effects create hilarious moments and real tension. Combat feels smooth and responsive. I’d like more enemy variety, yet it’s still a solid experience.
Super dynamic gameplay. I liked how unpredictable everything felt. Sometimes too unpredictable, but overall the chaos keeps things entertaining.
Fast, bright and chaotic in a good way. Each run feels like a new puzzle. Could benefit from a bit more content, but what’s here works really well.
Excellent for short sessions. The energy is great, and I liked testing different routes. Minor balance issues aside, it’s definitely recommendable.
Strong concept and fun execution. Experimenting with side effects adds depth. A few features feel underexplained, but nothing game-breaking.
There's still a long road ahead in development, but we can already see a very unusual concept with great potential for entertainment and fooling around. The platforming isn't very good yet.
I enjoyed the unique chaos of S.E.M.I. The cooperative element adds fun moments, but the game lacks depth and polish in execution. More content would greatly enhance the experience.
